items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: What got me back was Lou Irwin. Lou got a part for me to do in a picture, the Bill Robinson Story

ctx.x: I didn't sit with the actors, I sat with the bus driver and had a sandwich and a cup of coffee, but I didn't bother the actors, no more to do with it.

You know what this woman did? She took a tape just like you got there and recorded my act -- I'll never forget this as long as I live -- recorded my act and sent my act into Wiesbaden where the headquarters for the Special Service was and let the man over at headquarters hear it and that man from then on I was in the driver's seat. You understand? When he heard me entertain he must have contacted America and told America about me, 'cause as soon -- I don't get back right then, I'm there yet scruffing up money for…
So I get back here, leaving
